image_description: A close-up, candid shot of a wedding ceremony. The central figure is a groom in a dark suit and white shirt, looking down at his hands which are being held or adjusted by another person (likely the bride in a veil or an officiant/assistant). To the right, another man in a suit with a red boutonniere is partially visible. The image has a warm, indoor lighting tone and appears to be a photograph from a film camera given the date stamp.

While not gibberish, AI generators often struggle to replicate this specific aesthetic accurately, but here it looks authentic to a scanned photo. However, if this were an AI gen, text artifacts are common. Given the realism, this is likely a real photo artifact, but noted for completeness.
Natural depth-of-field blur and motion blur on the hands. This is consistent with photography, not necessarily an AI artifact, but the boundary between the veil and the background is soft.
